pages.text:
Makes Hydrogen from Natural Gas and steam, far cheaper than the Electrolyzer.
- 100 mB Natural Gas and 100 mB Steam make 100 mB Hydrogen and 25 mB Carbon Dioxide in 1 second, using 40 HU/t at 700°C or hotter.
- Natural Gas and Steam in the top, heat into the bottom. Hydrogen leaves by the left, Carbon Dioxide by the right (a gas port); it pushes both out on its own.
- Speed Upgrades make it faster.
The Carbon Dioxide can go to the Carbon Reclaimer or the Greenhouse, or a Flare Stack burns it off.
